test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 18 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
A question is given followed by two arguments. Decide which of the arguments is/are strong with respect to the question.

Question:

Should vegetarian food be banned in India?

Arguments:

I. No, it is cheap source of protein and other minerals and a lot of people can afford it.

II. No, it will violate people's freedom.
solution:
• The question is about the decision of banning vegetarian food in India.

 
• Argument 1 states the merits of vegetarian food. It explains how these foods are an affordable source of nutrition for a large number of people.
 
 
• Thus, argument 1 is strong.
 
 
 
• Argument 2 is against the idea of banning vegetarian food. The reason it states is that people should not be deprived of the freedom to choose what they wish to eat. Freedom of choice will be affected by this decision.
 
 
• Thus, argument 2 is also strong.
 
 

Hence, "both are strong" is the correct answer.
